description: This file defines the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter class responsible for managing execution approval prompts within the application. It handles incoming approval requests, determines whether prompts should be presented based on security policies and other criteria, and resolves decisions accordingly. It integrates with a gateway connection and manages asynchronous tasks related to approval workflows.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing and presention of execution approval prompts based on incoming requests and current security policies.

classes.name: GatewayApprovalRequest
classes.description: A Codable struct representing an approval request, including its ID, the request details, and timestamps.

classes.name: PresentationDecision
classes.description: A struct encapsulating the decision logic about whether to ask the user, if presentation is possible, and associated security policies.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the asynchronous task to listen and respond to approval request streams.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing approval request listening task.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously subscribes to the approval request stream and processes incoming pushes.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles individual approval push events by decoding payloads and determining whether to prompt the user or resolve automatically.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Determines if a prompt should be presented based on the request and current app/security policies.

methods.name: fallbackDecision
methods.description: Decides fallback actions when prompts cannot be presented, based on configured ask fallback policy and allowlist matching.

methods.name: fallbackResolution
methods.description: Resolves an executable command resolution for fallback based on request details.

methods.name: firstToken
methods.description: Extracts the first token from a command string.

methods.name: shouldPresent (static)
methods.description: Determines if a prompt should be shown based on connection mode, session keys, and user activity timing.
